prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes.     Scan area. If visible object, then approach & take it, move to target. Else, do task.     list of available nodes: <Action ID = ScanArea    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToTarget    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = ScanObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectMovable    /> <Action ID = MoveObjectToTarget    /> <SubTree ID = DoTask    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO MoveToTarget
	END
